source: brief/interview-brief.pdf — Applied AI Architect Presentation, Anthropic Virtual Onsite Interview

deliverables.D1: Slide deck with speaker notes (Slides artifact; exports to .pptx/PDF for the Google Slides template)
deliverables.D2: Live demo kit: three acts, runbook with exact prompts, setup/reset scripts, fallbacks
deliverables.D3: Run-of-show and talk track: minute-by-minute, time checkpoints, cut list
deliverables.D4: Stakeholder strategy: persona map, discovery questions, objection handling and Q&A bank
deliverables.D5: Metrics framework and ROI model, with an interactive ROI calculator
deliverables.D6: Evaluation and rollout plan (leave-behind) with specific starter use cases
deliverables.D7: Security and compliance brief and threat model (CTO leave-behind)
deliverables.D8: Wrap-up kit: next steps, mutual action plan, follow-up email
deliverables.D9: Interview logistics kit: 60-second intro, questions for Anthropic, pre-flight checklist
deliverables.D10: Claims register with sources, and competitive battlecard
deliverables.D11: Program dashboard showing the SDLC that produced D1-D10

requirements.text: Lead a 40-minute mock customer meeting with FinTechCo's executive team.
requirements.verify: Run-of-show sums to <= 40 min with a 2-min buffer; rehearsal timing (G4).

requirements.text: Slides: overview of how Claude Code works at a high level.
requirements.verify: Deck has a how-it-works section legible to non-engineers and engineers.

requirements.text: Slides: unique value proposition.
requirements.verify: One slide states the UVP in FinTechCo terms; claims sourced (G2).

requirements.text: Slides: competitive differentiators (FinTechCo is evaluating Claude Code alongside other AI coding assistants).
requirements.verify: Fair, sourced comparison; battlecard for Q&A.

requirements.text: Slides: how Claude Code addresses FinTechCo's diverse technical teams — 120 software engineers (payments, mobile, banking infra; Python/TypeScript/Java), 40 data scientists (fraud, credit scoring, customer behavior; Python/Jupyter/pandas/scikit-learn/TensorFlow), 20 SREs (incidents, uptime; Python/shell/Go).
requirements.verify: Per-team use cases named in their own stacks.

requirements.text: Slides: metrics/framework for measuring impact and ROI.
requirements.verify: Framework with leading and lagging metrics, baselines, guardrails; ROI with stated assumptions and sensitivity.

requirements.text: Slides: recommended evaluation plan with specific use cases to start.
requirements.verify: Named starter use cases per team, success criteria, decision gate, timeline.

requirements.text: Live demo: a prepared technical demonstration that connects to FinTechCo's use cases (guide: 10-15 minutes).
requirements.verify: Each act maps to a FinTechCo team; scripted dry-run passes (G3).

requirements.text: Wrap up: close out the meeting and propose clear next steps before ending, without running long.
requirements.verify: Next steps with owners and dates; wrap starts by 0:37 (ADR-005 checkpoint) with a 1-minute buffer after it.

requirements.text: Answer the CTO's question: why FinTechCo would benefit from Claude Code.
requirements.verify: Benefits tied to FinTechCo priorities: team productivity and shipping new products.

requirements.text: Answer: how FinTechCo should evaluate and roll it out; implementation complexity and timelines.
requirements.verify: Complexity assessment and a dated timeline to company-wide rollout within a few months.

requirements.text: Audience has different levels of technical expertise.
requirements.verify: Layered explanations: executive line first, technical depth on request; jargon defined.

requirements.text: Audience is particularly concerned about how to measure business impact.
requirements.verify: Impact measurement gets its own slide and a leave-behind.

requirements.text: ROI and business value must be clearly articulated.
requirements.verify: ROI scenarios with assumptions, payback, and an interactive calculator.

requirements.text: CTO: 20+ years in financial services IT, highly security-conscious, concerned about regulatory compliance, technically deep, skeptical without proven enterprise adoption.
requirements.verify: Security/compliance section and sourced enterprise proof points; objection answers reviewed by mock CTO (Sprint 3).

requirements.text: Head of Digital Transformation: champions AI, dotted-line leader of engineering, advocates for modern developer tools.
requirements.verify: Champion is equipped to sell internally: pilot charter, metrics, rollout plan.

requirements.text: Infrastructure on AWS and GCP serving US customers.
requirements.verify: Deployment options through Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI covered with data-flow diagram.

requirements.text: Priorities: team productivity and shipping new products; cost-conscious but not cost-driven.
requirements.verify: Value framed on throughput and time-to-market; cost controls shown, not led with.

requirements.text: Goal: roll out a single agentic coding tool company-wide within the next few months.
requirements.verify: Rollout reaches all 180 technical staff in about 4 months, with decision gate.

requirements.text: FinTechCo does not use any agentic coding tools today.
requirements.verify: Enablement and change management for a first agentic tool; explain agentic vs autocomplete.

requirements.text: They are evaluating Claude Code alongside other AI coding assistants.
requirements.verify: Evaluation protocol is fair and comparable across tools.

requirements.text: If running short on time, recognize it and adapt so there is time to wrap up.
requirements.verify: Time checkpoints and a cut list in the run-of-show.

requirements.text: 5 minutes at the end for the candidate's questions about Anthropic.
requirements.verify: Prepared, prioritized questions.

requirements.text: Test screen sharing on Google Meet.
requirements.verify: Pre-flight checklist covers Meet screen share, terminal font size, windows, fallbacks.

requirements.text: Old slides are a starting point only; successful presentations add, edit and delete to make their own.
requirements.verify: Original deck; mapping notes for porting into the provided Google Slides template.

requirements.text: Demo runs on Claude Code with the provided API key ($25 credits); install via the curl script.
requirements.verify: Measured cost per full demo run well under budget; install steps in runbook.

requirements.text: Demo topic options: common workflows (understand codebase, fix bug, add feature, refactor) and FRED data (acquisition, cleaning/EDA incl. Phillips curve flattening, modeling Fed policy vs volatility, dashboarding). Do not try to combine everything in 10-15 minutes.
requirements.verify: Deliberate selection documented in ADR-004; acts fit time box.

requirements.text: 5 minutes of introductions at the start, before the role play.
requirements.verify: 60-second candidate intro and role-play transition line.

requirements.text: Ground the content in the provided resources: Claude Code docs, Claude Code overview, Boris Cherny talk, Claude Code webinar.
requirements.verify: Claims cite official docs; talk themes captured where verifiable.

requirements.text: Show how you prepare for and run a real customer meeting (stated goal of the exercise).
requirements.verify: Prep artifacts visible: discovery, stakeholder map, rehearsal record, program board.
